EmailTemplate.textOnly:
You have been assigned {!Lead.SummaryCount} leads on {!Lead.SummaryDate} through Intel's Lead Management System. Please review these leads and contact these customers within the next 72 hours. Please accept or reject these leads as soon as possible.
Please click the following link to access the leads. https://partners.intel.com
